title: Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers
native_title: デビル・サマナー ソウル・ハッカーズ
overview:
In a futuristic model city dominated by the Algon corporation, the virtual reality network Paradigm-X is in limited trial. You are a member of the Spookies, a group of hackers investigating strange happenings in town. When the group gets hold of a gun-shaped computer called a COMP, you learn to use it to summon demons - just as your close friend Hitomi becomes possessed by the mysterious demon Nemissa.

Explore dungeons such as airports and corporate buildings in first person, as well as the virtual town inside Paradigm-X. Fight turn-based battles with swords, guns and magic, and talk with demons mid-battle to negotiate them into joining you. Keep your demons loyal, fuse them into new ones with the COMP, and upgrade the COMP with new functions.

- Separate currencies for the human and demon worlds
- 2 discs
- Memory backup support
